author: Central STL News
title: Pius Suter named to Swiss Olympic hockey team; joins three other Blues players
text:
Enterprise Center | St. Louis Blues
Enterprise Center | St. Louis Blues
St. Louis Blues forward Pius Suter has been selected to play for Team Switzerland at the 2026 Olympic Winter Games in Milano Cortina, according to an announcement made by Team Switzerland on Wednesday.
Switzerland is scheduled to begin its tournament against France on February 12 at 5:10 a.m. CT.
Suter, age 29, is currently in his first season with the St. Louis Blues after signing with the team on July 1, 2025. So far this season, he has accumulated 14 points—seven goals and seven assists—and has received 12 penalty minutes over the course of 37 games.
The upcoming Olympics will be Suter’s second appearance at the Games. At the 2018 Winter Olympics in South Korea, he scored five points, including three goals and two assists in four games.
Suter’s international experience also includes playing for Switzerland at both the 2022 and 2017 World Championships, as well as participating in the U-20 World Junior Championships in 2015 and 2016 and the U-18 World Junior Championship in 2013.
He becomes the fourth player from the Blues roster named to an Olympic team for these Games, joining Jordan Binnington (Canada), Colton Parayko (Canada), and Philip Broberg (Sweden).
